theorem erdos_773 :
    ∀ ε > (0 : ℝ), ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      (N : ℝ) ^ (1 - ε) ≤
        (Finset.maxSidonSubsetCard
          (Finset.image (fun n : ℕ => n ^ 2) (Finset.Icc 1 N)) : ℝ)
doc: What is the size of the largest Sidon subset $A\subseteq\{1,2^2,\ldots,N^2\}$? Is it $N^{1-o(1)}$?
